name: Circle of Spores
description: A druid subclass that adds the Spores tradition from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

grants.name: Circle Spells
grants.description: Gain Chill Touch and always prepare the Circle of Spores spells as your Druid level increases.

grants.name: Halo of Spores
grants.description: When a creature you can see moves within 10 feet or starts its turn there, use your Reaction to force a Constitution save; it takes Necrotic damage on a failure. The damage die scales with Druid level.

grants.name: Symbiotic Entity
grants.description: As an Action, expend Wild Shape to gain 4 temporary Hit Points per Druid level for 10 minutes. While they remain, double Halo of Spores damage and add 1d6 Necrotic damage to your melee weapon hits.

grants.name: Fungal Infestation
grants.description: When a Small or Medium Beast or Humanoid dies within 10 feet, use your Reaction to animate it as a 1-HP Zombie for 1 hour. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier per Long Rest.

grants.name: Spreading Spores
grants.description: While Symbiotic Entity is active, use a Bonus Action to create a 10-foot cube of spores within 30 feet for 1 minute. Creatures entering or starting there take your Halo of Spores damage on a failed save.

grants.name: Fungal Body
grants.description: You cannot be Blinded, Deafened, Frightened, or Poisoned, and critical hits against you become normal hits unless you are Incapacitated.
